title: IafdbBank
description: Calibrated + band-pass-filtered bipolar EGM segments extracted from PhysioNet IAFDB. Schema version 1.0. Symmetric with SyntheticBank: maps to an HDF5 file with bank-level root attrs plus a `traces/` group containing per-trace columns. No `label` column — labeling is downstream policy applied at ClassifierBank conversion time by a consumer-supplied label_fn.

schema_version.description: Schema version in X.Y form. X (major) bumps at release; Y (minor) bumps on every dev-time structural change. Consumers MUST refuse unknown major versions.

created_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp captured at write time.

source.description: Provenance tag identifying the upstream dataset. Bumps when the underlying PhysioNet dataset version changes.

fs_hz.description: Sampling rate in Hz. IAFDB is fixed at 1 kHz; enum (rather than const) so datamodel-code-generator emits a Literal[1000.0] in Pydantic and a concrete typed enum in C++. The exclusiveMinimum belt-and-suspenders catches malformed values that bypass the enum check.

calibration_method.description: How per-record amplitude calibration was computed. R-wave anchoring is always applied regardless of threshold strategy. Phase 1 only supports this one method; future methods would add new enum values rather than replacing this one.

calibration_target_qrs_pp_mv.description: Target peak-to-peak QRS amplitude in mV against which each record was calibrated.

threshold_mode.description: Threshold strategy that decided which segments are retained. 'absolute' = fixed mV cap; 'percentile' = per-record percentile of the calibrated p-p distribution.

threshold_value.description: Value used by the threshold strategy. mV for 'absolute' (e.g., 0.5 per Sánchez); 0..100 percentile for 'percentile'.

band_hz.description: Band-pass filter edges in Hz, [low, high]. Defaults to the clinical 30-300 Hz band.

window_ms.description: Sliding-window length in ms. Default 512 ms to match the classifier's T=512 input.

window_samples.description: Window length in samples (= window_ms * 1e-3 * fs_hz).

hop_ms.description: Stride between adjacent windows in ms. Additive (not in the original format-version-1 spec but recorded for reproducibility; readers MAY ignore it).

source_records.description: Record names that contributed at least one segment to this bank (e.g., 'iaf1_afw'). Allows zero entries (empty bank is valid).

traces.description: Per-trace columns. Maps to the HDF5 `traces/` group. All columns have first dimension N (the segment count) and are aligned.

signal.description: (N, window_samples) float32 — calibrated + band-pass-filtered bipolar EGM segments.

patient_id.description: (N,) UTF-8 — IAFDB patient identifier, one of 'iaf1'..'iaf8'.

source_channel.description: (N,) UTF-8 — Bipolar channel name within the source record (e.g., 'CS12').

start_sample.description: (N,) int64 — Sample offset of the segment into the source record. Combined with patient_id + source_record + window_samples, this uniquely identifies the trace's location in the raw IAFDB data.

peak_to_peak_mv.description: (N,) float32 — Calibrated peak-to-peak amplitude in mV that passed the threshold check. Real-mV interpretation.

calibration_scalar.description: (N,) float32 — Per-patient scalar applied to this segment during R-wave anchoring. signal_in_mv = signal_raw * calibration_scalar.
